headline: Ukrainians told the gas tariff from September 1, 2026: how much they will have to pay per cubic meter
summary: Consumers in Ukraine are being told the gas tariff that applies from September 1, 2026, with the amount per cubic meter and the deadline for paying for gas used.
why: Gas tariffs set household energy costs and shape the revenue of Ukraine's gas distribution and supply companies. Tariff changes feed into inflation and consumer spending.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Украинцам назвали тариф на газ с 1 сентября 2026 года: сколько нужно будет платить за 1 кубометр
